snippet.title: [Project: OXALIS] - Official Teaser (PROJECT PAUSED)
snippet.description:
[Project: OXALIS] is a fan-made sequel to the surreal Puzzle/Adventure game “OneShot”. One year after the events of Solstice, you and Niko find yourselves returning to this world. There will be consequences. Do you wish to proceed?

* The final demo for the RPG Maker build is available here:
https://eternabyte.itch.io/oneshot-aftermath
─────────────────────────────────────────────
Original Music by - smol machine ( https://smolmachine.bandcamp.com/ )
Animation and Editing by - Vixia (  https://vkspace.neocities.org/ )
Concept and Design by - Dj Robot ( https://bsky.app/profile/djrobot.bsky.social ) & Hazel ( https://bsky.app/profile/hazelroseraie.bsky.social )
─────────────────────────────────────────────
* Our website:
https://eternabyte.dev/
* Listen to the soundtrack here:
https://music.eternabyte.dev./
* Join the official Eternabyte Discord server:
https://discord.gg/pvSEcbCbn9
* Follow us on Twitter:
https://twitter.com/EternabyteDev
* Follow our Tumblr/Devlog:
https://eternabyte.tumblr.com/




#OneShotAftermath #OneShotGame #OSAM #OneShot
